title: Padding commutes with applying an action
statement: Let $k,K$ be natural numbers, let $S,H$ be types, let $	ext{emb}:S\to H$ be a map, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-tape machine with states in $S$, and let $a$ be an action of that machine. Applying the action padded along $	ext{emb}$ to the padded configuration equals padding along $	ext{emb}$ of the configuration obtained by applying $a$ to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: map emb from S to H
configuration c on k tapes with states in S
action a on k tapes with states in S
replaced:
Applying the padded version of an action to the padded version of a configuration
equals the padding of the result of applying the original action; the added high
tapes remain blank.
